answer.sameness: Nearly every hero is one of four recipes: (1) dark/colour band with left headline + small photo block right; (2) white page, headline left, info table (Naslov/Telefon/E-pošta, hours) right; (3) two-column text left, photo right, with a drop-cap paragraph under; (4) full-bleed photo with headline overlaid. Type is two families everywhere: a heavy condensed grotesk in all caps (avto, elektro, instalacije, kljucavnicarstvo, pekarna, prevajanje, racunovodstvo, salon-tina, zobozdravstvo) and the same serif display (brivnica, cvetlicarna, frizerstvo, gostilna, mizarstvo, pizzeria). Same CTA pair 'Pokličite / Navodila za pot', same thin header with tiny logo, same navy/dark green/dusty rose/mustar…
recurringIssues: The dark 'headline left, small photo tucked right' hero recurs on a dozen pages regardless of trade, so garage, locksmith, translator and dentist read as one site.
Large empty whites on desktop: instrukcije-pia-gen, mizarstvo-lesnik-gen, instalacije-rebernik-gen/regen, prevajanje-kolar-regen leave half the first screen blank.
Hero photos are cropped into thin strips or tiny squares (cvetlicarna-regen, elektro-zupan-regen, karoserija-hribar-gen, prevajanje-kolar-gen), killing the imagery that should differentiate.
Mobile first screens are often text-only or cut photos/headline mid-way; CTAs overlap content on several phone tiles (instalacije-rebernik-gen, zobozdravstvo-lebar-regen, kmetija-grabnar-regen).
Headline-size inconsistency: some pages run tiny headlines in a sea of space (cvetlicarna-gen, pizzeria-gen) while others oversize all-caps blocks that compete with nav.
Info-table hero (address/phone/hours) used as hero content on 8+ pages reads as a directory listing, not a brand.
Contrast lapses: thin serif headline on mid-tone green/rose photo blends (fizioterapija-gen, frizerstvo-lana-gen, gostisce-na-gricu-gen mustard body text).

best.why: Warm full-bleed bread photo, confident serif headline on dark gradient, header and CTA quietly placed; feels made for a bakery.
Green band plus the real house photo and a strong headline gives a sense of place; mobile version holds together too.
Big workshop photo over a dark band with a punchy condensed headline; clear, trade-appropriate, no wasted space.

weakest.why: Centred logo, cramped all-caps headline, info table and acres of white — looks like an unstyled document.
No imagery of wood or furniture at all on the first screen, just text floating in white; nothing says carpenter.
Tiny headline, directory-style info table and no flowers visible; the one trade that sells on colour gets none.

answer.oneChange: Retire the two-column 'headline + info table / small photo' hero and force every page to open with a business-specific, properly sized photograph and a layout chosen for that trade, with contact details moved below the fold; add at least two more type pairings so the condensed-caps/serif pair stops stamping every site.
answer.summary: The batch is competent but it is a template shop with four hero layouts, two typefaces and one button pair rotated across 50 pages. Several pages do work: pekarna-kvas-regen, gostilna-zlata-zlica-regen, avto-kovac-gen and kmetija-grabnar-gen use strong photography and feel built for the business. Too many others (instrukcije-pia-gen, mizarstvo-lesnik-gen, cvetlicarna-marjetica-gen, racunovodstvo, prevajanje) open on a contact table or a thin photo strip with large empty areas, so a florist, a translator and a locksmith look interchangeable. Mobile screens frequently cut headlines and photos and let the sticky CTA bar overlap content. Lead with the image, size headlines consistently, and vary type and layout by trade; the set would move from 3 toward 4.
